name: Unidentified probe droid (Gerrigon)
description: A probe droid of the Viper probe droid model was a member of the Galactic Empire. Between 14 BBY and 9 BBY, the probe droid undertook a mission to the astronomical object Gerrigon with the Fifth Brother inquisitor. The droid explained the history of Gerrigon before they were attacked by the Jedi Knight, Tensu Run.
